heading: Six Security Gates
content: Pavii checks every agent call at six gates: injection, privacy, supply chain, budget, egress and output. Pavii blocks a bad call before it can do harm.

heading: Private Data Stays Private
content: The privacy gate removes personal data and secrets before a model sees the prompt. Zero-knowledge proof designs let a provider check a fact without seeing the data.

heading: Rules on the Blockchain
content: Pavii keeps your important rules as smart contracts on Hyper 0X. The rules still apply when a model forgets an instruction in a long chat.

heading: Agentic Observability
content: See each call, tool, blocked action and cost for every agent. Each receipt links to the one before it on Hyper 0X, so nobody can secretly change the record.
